def polygon_diff( shape1: Shape, shape2: Shape, rel_tol: float | None = None, abs_tol: float | None = None, merge: bool = True) -> simetri.group.batch.Group: 
2404def polygon_diff(
2405    shape1: Shape,
2406    shape2: Shape,
2407    rel_tol: float | None = None,
2408    abs_tol: float | None = None,
2409    merge: bool = True,
2410) -> Group:
2411    """Return the difference of two closed polygons (``shape1 \\ shape2``).
2412
2413    Args:
2414        shape1: Shape to clip (must be closed).
2415        shape2: Clipping region (must be closed).
2416        rel_tol: Relative tolerance. Defaults to ``runtime_defaults["rel_tol"]``.
2417        abs_tol: Absolute tolerance. Defaults to ``runtime_defaults["abs_tol"]``.
2418        merge: If True, merge resulting edge fragments into shapes.
2419
2420    Returns:
2421        Group: Segments or merged shapes belonging to ``shape1`` outside
2422        ``shape2``.
2423
2424    Raises:
2425        Warning: If either shape is not closed (raised as ``Warning``).
2426
2427    Examples:
2428        >>> a = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (20, 0), (20, 20), (0, 20)], closed=True)
2429        >>> b = sg.Shape([(40, 40), (30, 40), (30, 30), (40, 30)], closed=True)
2430        >>> polygon_diff(a, b)  # doctest: +SKIP
2431    """
2432    exclude_clipper = False
2433    if not (shape1.closed and shape2.closed):
2434        raise Warning("Both shapes must be closed")
2435
2436    rel_tol, abs_tol = resolve_tol(rel_tol, abs_tol)
2437    segments = [[p1[:2], p2[:2]] for (p1, p2) in shape1.edges] + [
2438        [p1[:2], p2[:2]] for (p1, p2) in shape2.edges
2439    ]
2440    intersections = all_intersections(segments, rel_tol=rel_tol, abs_tol=abs_tol)
2441
2442    all_segments_ = []
2443    for key, value in intersections[0].items():
2444        segment = segments[key]
2445        points = [x[0] for x in value]
2446        points = remove_duplicate_points(points)
2447        all_segments_.append(multi_split_segment(segment, points))
2448
2449    diff_ = Group()
2450    shape_vertices = shape1.vertices
2451    shape2_vertices = shape2.vertices
2452    for segs in all_segments_:
2453        for seg in segs:
2454            in1 = in_polygon(midpoint(*seg), shape_vertices)
2455            in2 = in_polygon(
2456                midpoint(*seg), shape2_vertices, not exclude_clipper
2457            )
2458            if in1 and not in2:
2459                diff_.append(Shape(seg))
2460
2461    if merge:
2462        diff_ = diff_.merge_shapes()
2463
2464    return diff_

Return the difference of two closed polygons (shape1 \ shape2).

Arguments:
  • shape1: Shape to clip (must be closed).
  • shape2: Clipping region (must be closed).
  • rel_tol: Relative tolerance. Defaults to runtime_defaults["rel_tol"].
  • abs_tol: Absolute tolerance. Defaults to runtime_defaults["abs_tol"].
  • merge: If True, merge resulting edge fragments into shapes.
Returns:

Group: Segments or merged shapes belonging to shape1 outside shape2.

Raises:
  • Warning: If either shape is not closed (raised as Warning).
Examples:
>>> a = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (20, 0), (20, 20), (0, 20)], closed=True)
>>> b = sg.Shape([(40, 40), (30, 40), (30, 30), (40, 30)], closed=True)
>>> polygon_diff(a, b)  # doctest: +SKIP

def polygon_intersection( shape1: Shape, shape2: Shape, merge: bool = True) -> Shape | simetri.group.batch.Group: 
2496def polygon_intersection(
2497    shape1: Shape, shape2: Shape, merge: bool = True
2498) -> Shape | Group:
2499    """Return the intersection of two closed polygons.
2500
2501    Args:
2502        shape1: First closed shape.
2503        shape2: Second closed shape.
2504        merge: If True, merge resulting edge fragments.
2505
2506    Returns:
2507        Group: Intersection fragments or merged shapes.
2508
2509    Examples:
2510        >>> a = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40), (0, 40)], closed=True)
2511        >>> b = sg.Shape([(20, 20), (60, 20), (60, 60), (20, 60)], closed=True)
2512        >>> polygon_intersection(a, b)  # doctest: +SKIP
2513    """
2514    if not (shape1.closed and shape2.closed):
2515        raise ValueError("Invalid input: shape1 and shape2 must be closed!")
2516    return clip(shape1, shape2, merge=merge)

def polygon_xor( shape1: Shape, shape2: Shape, rel_tol: float | None = None, abs_tol: float | None = None, merge: bool = True) -> simetri.group.batch.Group: 
2519def polygon_xor(
2520    shape1: Shape,
2521    shape2: Shape,
2522    rel_tol: float | None = None,
2523    abs_tol: float | None = None,
2524    merge: bool = True,
2525) -> Group:
2526    """Return the symmetric difference of two closed polygons.
2527
2528    Args:
2529        shape1: First closed shape.
2530        shape2: Second closed shape.
2531        rel_tol: Relative tolerance. Defaults to ``runtime_defaults["rel_tol"]``.
2532        abs_tol: Absolute tolerance. Defaults to ``runtime_defaults["abs_tol"]``.
2533        merge: If True, merge the combined result.
2534
2535    Returns:
2536        Group: Symmetric difference fragments or merged shapes.
2537
2538    Examples:
2539        >>> a = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (20, 0), (20, 20), (0, 20)], closed=True)
2540        >>> b = sg.Shape([(40, 40), (30, 40), (30, 30), (40, 30)], closed=True)
2541        >>> polygon_xor(a, b)  # doctest: +SKIP
2542    """
2543    res1 = polygon_diff(shape1, shape2, rel_tol=rel_tol, abs_tol=abs_tol)
2544    res2 = polygon_diff(shape2, shape1, rel_tol=rel_tol, abs_tol=abs_tol)
2545
2546    res = Group([res1, res2])
2547
2548    if merge:
2549        res = res.merge_shapes(rel_tol=rel_tol, abs_tol=abs_tol)
2550
2551    return res

def trim_margins( item: Shape | simetri.group.batch.Group, left: float = 0, bottom: float = 0, right: float = 0, top: float = 0) -> Shape | simetri.group.batch.Group: 
2147def trim_margins(
2148    item: Shape | Group,
2149    left: float = 0,
2150    bottom: float = 0,
2151    right: float = 0,
2152    top: float = 0,
2153) -> Shape | Group:
2154    """Trim the margins of a Shape or Group.
2155
2156    Args:
2157        item (Shape | Group): The Shape or Group to trim.
2158        left (float, optional): The left margin to trim. Defaults to 0.
2159        bottom (float, optional): The bottom margin to trim. Defaults to 0.
2160        right (float, optional): The right margin to trim. Defaults to 0.
2161        top (float, optional): The top margin to trim. Defaults to 0.
2162
2163    Returns:
2164        Shape | Group: The trimmed Shape or Group.
2165
2166    Examples:
2167        >>> square = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40), (0, 40)], closed=True)
2168        >>> trimmed = trim_margins(square)
2169        >>> trimmed
2170        Group()
2171    """
2172    corners = item.b_box.get_inflated_b_box(
2173        -left, -bottom, -right, -top
2174    ).corners
2175    clipper = Shape(corners, closed=True)
2176
2177    return clip(item, clipper, exclude_clipper=True)
